<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">Route</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A route is a path through a road network over which someone travels.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> Each <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-section" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>Section</code></a> of a route contains a list of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sectionnotice" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>SectionNotice</code></a> objects
 that describe <em>potential issues</em> after the route was calculated. If the list is non-empty,
 it is recommended to evaluate possible violations against the requested route options and
 reject the route if deemed necessary.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routingoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">RoutingOptions</a>&nbsp;getRoutingOptions()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the options used to calculate this route.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The set of options used to calculate the route.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getRailwayCrossings()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getRailwayCrossings</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routerailwaycrossing" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">RouteRailwayCrossing</a>&gt;&nbsp;getRailwayCrossings()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets railway crossings.
 <p>Railway crossing information is only available for routes created with the online <code>RoutingEngine</code>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Collection of railway crossings along the route.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getRouteLabels()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getRouteLabels</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-routelabel" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing">RouteLabel</a>&gt;&nbsp;getRouteLabels()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets route labels.
 <p>The main street names or route numbers through which the route is going to pass that differentiate it from other alternatives routes.
 The labels are ordered by importance based on how much time the route spends on each road segment, not by traversal sequence. This helps users quickly identify and distinguish between different route alternatives
 when alternative routes have been quested via <code>RouteOptions</code>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>A collection containing a maximum of 2 <code>RouteLabel</code> instances for the route. It will return an empty list if no labels are available.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
</li>
</ul>
